 "data": "usecase-beta
direction LR

actor Admin(\"管理员\")
actor Clerk(\"店员\")
actor Manager(\"店长\")

systemBoundary Shop[\"单店超市管理系统 P1\"]
 UploadAttachment(\"上传收货附件\")
 ReceiveGoods(\"采购实收登记\")
 ReviewReceipt(\"收货审核\")

 AfterSalesLocate(\"售后专用原单定位\")
 ReturnGoods(\"退货办理\")
 ExchangeGoods(\"换货办理\")

 Sell(\"销售出库\")
 Promotion(\"促销计价\")
 VoidDoc(\"单据作废/反向冲销\")

 Replenish(\"货架补货\")
 QueryDocs(\"查询单据/库存流水\")
 Login(\"本地登录\")

 ProductMaintain(\"商品维护\")
 PromotionConfig(\"促销配置\")
 OpeningStock(\"期初库存登记\")

 LossRecord(\"报损登记\")
 LossCorrect(\"报损修正\")
end

%% 管理员
Admin -- Login
Admin -- ProductMaintain
Admin -- PromotionConfig
Admin -- OpeningStock
Admin -- QueryDocs
Admin -- ReviewReceipt
Admin -- LossCorrect
Admin -- VoidDoc

%% 店员
Clerk -- Login
Clerk -- Replenish
Clerk -- Sell
Clerk -- QueryDocs
Clerk -- ReturnGoods
Clerk -- ExchangeGoods
Clerk -- VoidDoc

%% 店长：全部反写，保证店长在右侧
Login -- Manager
ProductMaintain -- Manager
PromotionConfig -- Manager
OpeningStock -- Manager
ReceiveGoods -- Manager
ReviewReceipt -- Manager
Replenish -- Manager
Sell -- Manager
QueryDocs -- Manager
ReturnGoods -- Manager
ExchangeGoods -- Manager
LossRecord -- Manager
VoidDoc -- Manager

%% include / extend
Sell ..> : include Promotion
UploadAttachment ..> : extend ReceiveGoods
AfterSalesLocate ..> : extend ReturnGoods
AfterSalesLocate ..> : extend ExchangeGoods

classDef uc fill:#E8FBF7,stroke:#2AB5A0,stroke-width:1.5px,color:#123333
classDef system fill:#F7F4FF,stroke:#7B61FF,stroke-width:2px
